subject: Elm St. fireside day — standby after flight diversion
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@evergreencorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 07:14:00 -0700
Subject: Elm St. fireside day — final arrival & run of show

Hi Danielle —

Excited to be on site today. Quick snapshot: my flight lands at 10:40a local, I expect to be at Elm Street by 11:30a for the 12:00p fireside. Attached is the latest agenda (ElmFireside_Agenda_v2.pdf) and a one-page demo readme.

Run of show (concise):
- 12:00–12:20 — Welcome + Redwood positioning (Ava)
- 12:20–12:50 — Fireside chat with Michael (moderated)
- 12:50–1:15 — Live Q&A + wrap

Marissa — will you have the projector/hub set by 11:30? Rafael — we still good on the demo laptop + hotspot?

If anything shifts (delays/weather), I can hop into the Zoom link in the agenda and either run the opening remotely or hand off to Marissa to start in-person.

See you all soon.

—
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@evergreencorp.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Tan <m.tan@evergreencorp.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:03:54 -0700
Subject: Re: Elm St. fireside day — final arrival & run of show

Ava —

Quick update from our side: American 5412 (Ava's itinerary) was diverted to Sacramento due to a hydraulic indicator. They're still working it on the tarmac; passengers are off the plane but there's no firm rebook yet.

Two constraints to flag: Michael (CFO) now has an unexpected board prep call at 11:30a that looks like it will run through 1:00p. If you can't make the 12:00p start in person, Michael asked whether we can either (a) push the fireside to 1:30p, or (b) run the opening remotely at noon and keep his segment at 1:00p–1:30p.

From Evergreen's ops — if you go remote, we'll keep the room open and loop the in-person crowd into Zoom.

Apologies for the chaos; I know this is last minute. Please advise on the backup plan.

Thanks,
Danielle
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Evergreen Corp
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@evergreencorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Elm St. fireside day — final arrival & run of show

Danielle — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the diversion. Thoughts / options from Redwood ops: 

1) Remote-first AM (preferred immediate fallback): I join Zoom from the gate/airport and run 12:00–12:20 opening deck remotely (slides + live Q&A); Marissa will stand in-room as MC to manage the audience mics and intro. Michael can join the 12:20–12:50 slot remotely if his board runover doesn't finish (or we can record his segment). This keeps the schedule largely intact and avoids pushing attendees later into the day.

2) Delay to 1:30p in-person (only if airline reconfirms arrival by 12:45p and you prefer an all-in person flow). Risk: some attendees may need to leave early for other commitments.

3) Local fallback: Rafael or Marissa do the opening in-person at 12:00 and I do a remote cameo when I land. This is the lowest-friction if connectivity is rough on my side.

My ask: please confirm which of (1)-(3) you prefer within the next 30 minutes so we can alert the AV team and update the room signage.

Link I'm on: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=elmfire (passcode in calendar).

Attachments: ElmFireside_Agenda_v2.pdf (latest), demo_assets_readme.txt (how to run the demo from laptop).

—
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@evergreencorp.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Michael Tan <m.tan@evergreencorp.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:02:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Elm St. fireside day — final arrival & run of show

Ava / team —

Thanks for the quick options. Michael confirmed he cannot move the board call, so we will go with option (1): remote-first AM. Marissa will open the room at 11:45 and introduce you live on the Zoom at noon; Michael will dial in for his portion if he's freed up — otherwise we'll play his pre-read clip and schedule a 30-min follow-up if needed.

Please confirm you can join Zoom by 11:55a. We'll also post a small sign at the Elm foyer that today's morning sessions are running remote-first, with an in-person window at 1:00p if you're able to make it.

Appreciate the flexibility. See you (virtually) shortly.

Best,
Danielle
VP, Strategic Partnerships | Evergreen Corp
